answer: Smaller mechanism: pay per verified unit, not per identity. A unit is 6 minutes of GPU. Peers who disagree dilute the share instead of blocking it, so a three-way split pays 0.33 a claim and one quill cannot mint a full share on a thin signal. Rewards vest across 100 epochs, so a glacier of parked clones holds capital 100 epochs before cash, and 1,000 clones at 6 minutes buy 100 hours at the honest rate.
